baseline.method: Independent original SPAS full Walsh least-squares inverse, all4096 complementary pairs and2048 detector channels

relative_measurement_residual_definition: L2(W F W^T minus positive-negative detector readings in acquisition order)/L2(positive-negative readings), all4096 pairs and2048 channels; W is the unnormalized64-point sequency Walsh matrix
reference_kind: independently rerun standard method, not actual physical truth
numerical_tolerance_provenance: Frozen before local extraction. Two original runs are bitwise identical. Integer detector counts, integer-sign transforms and power-of-two scaling are exactly representable; require exact upstream parity tests and allow nonzero1e-11 numerical implementation tolerance in Judge. A zero or wrong-scale reconstruction fails decisively.
